violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: Chlorine sanitizer final rinse dishmachine was observed to be 0 ppm.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. NOTE: Dishmachine repaired during the inspection, and a 200 ppm chlorine sanitizer residual was observed

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: Dishmachine was not providing required chlorine sanitizer concentration at the start of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. NOTE: Dishmachine repaired during the inspection so that required sanitizer residual was provided.
